package.name: ur_assembly_demo
package.description: Fiducial-guided pick-and-ASSEMBLE demo for the UR10e + Robotiq 2F-85. Picks an object exactly like ur_pick_place_demo (which it subclasses), then goes to a view pose, detects a marker on the target assembly, estimates the target object pose, pre-aligns and stands off along a specified axis, tares the F/T sensor, switches to the ros2_control admittance_controller, and compliantly mates the held part into the target -- then releases and retracts.
